def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # normalize text columns
    for col in ['species', 'island', 'sex']:
        df[col] = df[col].astype('string').str.strip()
    # fix label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Adelie': 'Adelie'})
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.capitalize().replace({'Biscoe': 'Biscoe', 'Dream': 'Dream', 'Torgersen': 'Torgersen'})
    # body_mass_g stored as text with commas -> numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype('string').str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # enforce allowed ranges if present
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    # keep id column and all rows; missing sex handled at answer time
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = df[df['sex'].notna() & df['body_mass_g'].notna()].copy()
    grouped = d.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grouped.items()}
